y-m-29-08.title: Umgca wabelana ngamachaphaza amangaphi neparabola?
y-m-29-08.topic: Iigrafu zemisebenzi ye-quadratic nemigca: inani lamachaphaza okudibana nexabiso lika-k
y-m-29-08.goal: Vavanya ingcinga 'iyasebenza kwimizekelo embalwa, ngoko isoloko isebenza' kwiindawo apho ixabiso litshintsha, yenza ngokwakho imizekelo enamachaphaza okudibana angama-2, uze ucacise ngexabiso elincinci ukuba kutheni kukho ichaphaza eli-1 lokudibana okanye akukho nalinye.
y-m-29-08.material:
Zoba iparabola y=x² nomgca y=2x+k kwi-plane enye yeekhowudinethi. U-k yinani elimisela ikhowudinethi ye-y yechaphaza apho umgca udibana khona ne-eksisi ye-y. (y=2x+k ifundwa 'y ilingana no-x kabini kudibaniswe no-k', kwaye x²-2x ifundwa 'x isikwere ukhuphe x kabini'.) Iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza okudibana kweegrafu ezimbini zi-x ezanelisa x²=2x+k, oko kukuthi, x²-2x=k. Ngezantsi yitheyibhile yamaxabiso ka-x²-2x. Funda itheyibhile ngokuthe tyaba.
  x       | -2 | -1 |  0 |  1 |  2 |  3 |  4
  x²-2x   |  8 |  3 |  0 | -1 |  0 |  3 |  8
y-m-29-08.thinking.0: Ukukhetha apho ungavavanya khona ukuqhubela phambili
y-m-29-08.thinking.2: Ukucacisa ukuba kutheni inani lamachaphaza okudibana litshintsha
y-m-29-08.prereq.0: Igrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic y=x² netheyibhile yamaxabiso ebinzana afana no-x²-2x (inqanaba lebanga lesi-3 lesikolo samabanga aphakathi)
y-m-29-08.prereq.1: Ikhowudinethi ye-x yechaphaza lokudibana yi-x apho amaxabiso e-y eebinzana ezimbini alingana khona
y-m-29-08.s.s1.prompt: Kwitheyibhile, xa k=3 iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza okudibana zi-−1 no-3, kwaye xa k=0 zi-0 no-2, ngoko kukho amachaphaza okudibana angama-2 kwiimeko zombini. UMinjun ucinga, 'Nokuba u-k linani lini, umgca y=2x+k udibana neparabola kumachaphaza angama-2.' Yeyiphi eyona ndlela intle yokuvavanya ingcinga kaMinjun?
y-m-29-08.s.s1.hint.0: Funda amaxabiso ka-x²-2x kwitheyibhile ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene uze uqwalasele ukuba amaxabiso atshintsha njani (aqhubeka ekhula, okanye atshintsha icala).
y-m-29-08.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha amaxabiso ambalwa ka-k, bala ukuba ngama-x amangaphi kwitheyibhile anelisa x²-2x=k, uze uthelekise ngokufutshane ukuba u-k ukuphi xa inani litshintsha.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.a: Khetha uze uvavanye amanani emvelo amancinci angekho kwitheyibhile, afana no-k=1, k=2, k=5
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.a: Ukuvavanya kulungile, kodwa akukho mgangatho wokuba kujongwe ntoni xa ukhetha amaxabiso. Qala ufumane apho amaxabiso atshintsha khona kwitheyibhile.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.b: Khetha uze uvavanye u-k kufutshane nalapho amaxabiso kwitheyibhile ehla aze abuye anyuke (-1 okanye -2)
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.b: Uthathe njengesalathiso ukuba indawo enexabiso elincinci kwitheyibhile yeyona apho inani lamachaphaza okudibana linokutshintsha khona.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.c: Yomibini imizekelo bekuyi-2, ngoko kwanele, yamkela ingcinga kaMinjun njengoko injalo
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.c: Uqinisekise 'nokuba linani lini' kwimizekelo embalwa. Zisenokubakho iindidi zika-k ezingekavavanywa.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.d: Vavanya amaxabiso ambalwa angakumbi ka-k amakhulu kuneetheyibhile, afana no-k=8, k=15, k=24
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.d: Uqokelela kuphela amaxabiso amaninzi olwahlulo olufanayo (u-k omkhulu). Jonga ukuba amaxabiso ka-x²-2x atshintsha njani kwitheyibhile.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.explain: Ukuqokelela imizekelo emininzi yohlobo olufanayo akuyi kuvelisa umzekelo ochasayo. Inani lamachaphaza okudibana linokutshintsha kufutshane nalapho ixabiso lika-x²-2x lilelona lincinci (-1 xa x=1 kwitheyibhile). Ngoko ukukhetha u-k kufutshane noko kuxabiso, njenge-k=-1 okanye k=-2, nokuhlola, luvavanyo lwenene. Masicacise isizathu kwinyathelo lokugqibela.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.prompt: Fumana amaxabiso amathathu ahlukeneyo ka-k apho umgca neparabola zidibana kumachaphaza angama-2 ngqo kwaye iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza omabini okudibana ngamanani aphelele. Ngenisa u-k neekhowudinethi ze-x x₁ no-x₂ zamachaphaza amabini okudibana. (U-x₁ no-x₂ ngamanani aphelele asuka ku-−9 ukuya ku-9.)
y-m-29-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kwitheyibhile, fumana imiqolo apho ixabiso elifanayo livela kabini, uze ubhale eli xabiso njengo-k namaxabiso e-x ngelo xesha njengo-x₁ no-x₂.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-k owufumeneyo kwi-x²=2x+k uze ubale ngqo ukuhlola ukuba omabini u-x achanekile.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.var.x1: Ikhowudinethi ye-x yechaphaza elinye lokudibana x₁
y-m-29-08.s.s2.var.x2: Ikhowudinethi ye-x yelinye ichaphaza lokudibana x₂
y-m-29-08.s.s2.ok.c1: U-k, x₁, no-x₂ ngamanani aphelele ahambelana neemeko.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Yenza u-k, x₁, no-x₂ babe ngamanani aphelele uze wenze u-x₁ no-x₂ basuke ku-−9 baye ku-9.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza amabini okudibana ziyahluka komnye nomnye.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukuba u-x₁ no-x₂ bafana, kukho ichaphaza elinye lokudibana. Bhala amaxabiso amabini ahlukeneyo.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.fail.c3: U-x₁ okanye u-x₂ akanelisi x²=2x+k. Faka ngqo uthelekise macala omabini.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.explain: Fumana imiqolo kwitheyibhile apho ixabiso elifanayo livela kabini: ixabiso 0 likwi-x=0 nango-2, ixabiso 3 likwi-x=-1 nango-3, kwaye ixabiso 8 likwi-x=-2 nango-4. Ngaphandle kwezi, nawuphi na umbini onamanani aphelele onga-x₁+x₂=2 uyasebenza (umz. x=-3 nango-5 kunika k=15), kwaye amachaphaza amabini okudibana ngumgama ofanayo ekhohlo nasekunene ku-x=1. Ukutshintshisa u-x₁ no-x₂ kunika u-k ofanayo, ngoko ngumzekelo ofanayo.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.prompt: Xa k=-1 kukho ichaphaza eli-1 kuphela lokudibana, kwaye xa k=-2 akukho nalinye. Cacisa ukuba kutheni, usebenzisa itheyibhile (okanye ibinzana).
y-m-29-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kwitheyibhile, fumana elona lincinci kumaxabiso ka-x²-2x kwaye livela kwi-x ni.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba ingaba k=-1 no-k=-2 balingana okanye bancinci kunelo xabiso lincinci, uze ucinge ukuba ikhona na i-x eyanelisa x²-2x=k ngelo xesha.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba unike ubungqina bokuba ixabiso elincinci lika-x²-2x lingakanani ukusuka kwitheyibhile (okanye kwibinzana)?
y-m-29-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe u-k=-1 no-k=-2 ngamnye ukuphi xa kuthelekiswa nelo xabiso?
y-m-29-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba usebenzise unxibelelwano lokuba 'iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza okudibana zi-x ezanelisa x²-2x=k'?
y-m-29-08.s.s3.model.0: Ixabiso elincinci lika-x²-2x yi-−1 xa x=1. Ngoko ukuba k=-1 badibana kuphela kwi-x=1, elilichaphaza elinye, kwaye k=-2 mncinci kunako, ngoko akukho chaphaza apho badibana khona.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.model.1: Kwitheyibhile, u-x²-2x akaze aye ngaphantsi kwe-−1. Ukuba k=-1, i-x=1 kuphela esebenzayo, kwaye kwi-k=-2 akukho x osebenzayo, ngoko akukho ndawo yokudibana.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.model.2: x²-2x=(x-1)²-1, ngoko akanakuba ngaphantsi kwe-−1. Ngoko k=-1 badibana kwindawo enye kuphela, x=1, kwaye k=-2 akanasisombululo.

y-m-29-01.title: Sisiphi isicwangciso esifanele kakuhle umntakwethu omncinci?
y-m-29-01.topic: Ukusebenzisa imisebenzi elayinini: ukuthelekisa izicwangciso ezimbini nokusetyenziswa emphethweni
y-m-29-01.goal: Chaza ubungakanani obubini obukhula ngesantya esifanayo, njengeentlawulo, ngemisebenzi elayinini, ufunde ukuba okuthengiswa ngexabiso eliphantsi kunokuxhomekeka ekusetyenzisweni, ulungise uluvo nokuqiniseka kwakho xa kufika idatha entsha, uze uyile isicwangciso esitsha esihambelana neemeko wena.
y-m-29-01.material:
Umntakwethu omncinci ufuna ukukhetha isicwangciso sedatha yefowuni. Ukuba ukusetyenziswa ngenyanga yi-x GB (inani le-0 okanye ngaphezulu, iidesimali zinokwenzeka), intlawulo yenyanga y (원) yezicwangciso ezimbini injengalo.
Isicwangciso A: intlawulo esisiseko 3000원 + 500원 nge-1GB nganye, oko kukuthi y=500x+3000
Isicwangciso B: intlawulo esisiseko 6000원 + 300원 nge-1GB nganye, oko kukuthi y=300x+6000
(y=500x+3000 ifundwa ngokuthi 'y ilingana neshumi elinesihlanu x kunye nesithathu samawaka'. Cinga ukuba intlawulo nge-1GB ayitshintshi nokuba ukusetyenziswa kuphezulu. Imali yinto eyenziwe ngokucinga.)

y-m-29-02.title: Ingaba umgca okhula ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi uhlala ukwindawo ephezulu?

y-m-29-02.material: UJia uthe, 'Kumsebenzi womgca y=ax+b, olo lunethambeka a elikhulu lunyuka kakhulu xa x inyuka nge-1. y-m-29-03.title: Igrafu ye-(x-2)² yaswelekiswa ngaphi?
y-m-29-03.topic: Iigrafu zemisebenzi yekhwadratiki: icala lokuhambisa kwi-y=a(x-p)²+q
y-m-29-03.goal: Hlola ukuba icala lokuhamba elimiselwe kuphela bubume bentetho lihambelana namaxabiso asetheyibhileni, gweba icala lokuhamba ngokusekelwe ekuhambeleni indawo apho amaxabiso alingana khona, uze usebenzise lo mthetho kwintetho entsha.
y-m-29-03.material:
UHaeun uthethe ngokuba igrafu ye-y=(x-2)² ihanjiswe ngaphi kwigrafu ye-y=x². 'Kwintetho, i-2 ikhutshwa kwi-x, ngoko x ehlile nge-2. Ngoko yigrafu ehanjiswe ngasekhohlo nge-2.' (y=(x-2)² ifundwa 'y ilingana nokuvula kwebhrakethi x ukususa ezimbini ukuvala kwebhrakethi isikwere'. Ukuhambisa kuthetha ukuba igrafu yonke iyahamba ugcina ubume bayo. Ikhohlo licala apho x iba ncinci, kwaye ekunene licala apho x iba nkulu.) UHaeun wenze itheyibhile ngokufaka amanani endaweni ka-x ukufumana y. Funda itheyibhile ngokuthe tye.

y-m-29-03.s.s1.o.a: UHaeun uchanekile. Kwintetho x ehlile nge-2, ngoko ihambele kwicala apho x incinci, oko kukuthi ngasekhohlo nge-2
y-m-29-03.s.s1.r.a: Ugqibe icala ngobume bentetho (x-2) kuphela. Awuhlolanga ukuba amaxabiso asetheyibhileni ayahambelana na nelo cala.

y-m-29-03.s.s1.o.c: Ii-x ezinika amaxabiso 0, 1, no-4 e-y=x² zonke zi-2 ezinkulu kwi-y=(x-2)²
y-m-29-03.s.s1.r.c: Ulinganise ukuba amaxabiso amaninzi ahanjiswa ngumthetho ofanayo na. Usebenzise ukuhamba kwegrafu yonke, hayi inqaku elinye, njengobungqina.
y-m-29-03.s.s1.o.d: Amachaphaza ambalwa kwitheyibhile awanakuxela icala lokuhamba, ngoko awunakugweba de uzobe igrafu
y-m-29-03.s.s1.r.d: Le yingcinga enenkathalo yokuba kunzima ukuqiniseka ngamachaphaza ambalwa kuphela. Kodwa ukuba amaxabiso amaninzi kwitheyibhile ahanjiswa ngumthetho ofanayo, ubungqina buyaqokelelana. Zama ukuhambelanisa iindawo zamaxabiso 0, 1, no-4.

Zonke ziyi-2 ngasekunene (icala apho x iba nkulu). Icala likaHaeun alihambelani netheyibhile. Oku kungenxa yokuba x kufuneka ibe ngama-2 amakhulu ukufumana ixabiso le-y elifanayo.

y-m-29-03.s.s2.r.b: Uphethe ngokwahlukeneyo inani elongezwe ku-x kunye nenani elongezwe kuyo yonke intetho.

y-m-29-04.title: Igadi yemifuno ecaleni kodonga: yeyiphi imo enendawo enkulu kakhulu?

USua ucinga, 'Okukhona a inkulu, kokukhona ububanzi buya kuba bumfutshane.' Masihlole ukuba le ngcinga ilunge na ngokujonga iitafile enye ngexesha.
